source_snapshot.criteria: Normal operation, BMC correctable parity event without slot, lights off, applicable UEFI slot attribution and Cscript injection success.

old_problem: The literal call places positional `mc, channel` after keyword `hbm=-1`; package namespace/signature, CAP semantics, controller targets, exact corrected-parity oracle and recovery are unapproved.
disposition_reason: The transient parity purpose is identifiable and an expected Intel package/runbook can resolve it, so missing syntax does not by itself meet the skill's irreducible BLOCKED boundary. It is nevertheless a core command-semantic gap: ED-03 cannot authorize silently repairing or copying a different-row interface, and ED-16 forbids injection until the exact supported signature, CAP meaning, topology, oracle and recovery are approved.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 20 and 21 with literal commands, Criteria and DeepSeek fields.
Read historical record 2425 and preserved exact identity/hashes.
Confirmed positional-after-keyword syntax is non-runnable; no corrected namespace or ordering is inferred.
A distinct row 163 example may inform the missing authority but cannot be copied into this source variant.
Preserve CAP-on, per-controller coverage, correctable/no-slot BMC behavior, off indicators and Cscript success.
No BIOS/CAP change, injection, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Transient DRAM command/address parity injection — authoritative interface required
test_case.purpose: Inject one transient command/address parity event into every approved controller/channel with CAP enabled and verify successful Cscript injection, corrected handling, normal operation and required no-light behavior.
required_package: Approved Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash, namespace and valid fully named injectCMDParity signature
Authoritative CAP definition and required state
Isolated-SUT recovery and BIOS/CAP restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: NO INJECTION AUTHORIZED. Do not execute or silently repair `ei.injectCMDParity(socket, hbm=-1, mc, channel)`. After the Intel/FAE authority supplies the supported fully named call for this package, a new review-layer revision must bind each target and retain one-shot execution plus complete evidence.
test_case.expected_result: Once the interface is approved, each target must show Cscript CMD Parity Injection success, the signed transient/corrected response, normal operation, BMC no-slot behavior, applicable UEFI evidence and both indicators off.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS exists until the exact valid interface and CAP/target semantics are approved. A syntax error, borrowed command, generic parity keyword, wrong severity/target, missing evidence, instability or incomplete restoration is not PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT, stable power, backup, console and qualified FAE approval.
Preserve CAP/register/log state and use only the formally approved fully resolved call.
One bounded target at a time; stop on wrong severity, error storm, crash or data concern.
No automatic retry or inferred syntax correction.
expected_evidence: Approved package hash/runbook and exact valid signature
Pre/post BIOS and CAP state plus target matrix
Exact command and full Cscript success output
test_case.recovery: The approving interface specification must include stop/recovery semantics. On unexpected severity or instability, preserve evidence and let the qualified owner restore CAP/debug settings and health; never retry automatically.
